Name: Waveform
Description: Specifies the type of waveform used to apply the fold or wave transformation to the terrain. The waveform determines the shape and style of the folds.

Flubs.Name: Sine
Flubs.Description: Applies a smooth, sinusoidal wave pattern, creating gentle, rolling folds.

Flubs.Name: Triangle
Flubs.Description: Applies a triangular wave pattern, resulting in sharp, angular folds with linear transitions.

Flubs.Name: Sawtooth
Flubs.Description: Applies a sawtooth wave pattern, producing repeating, ramp-like folds with abrupt drops.

Name: Folds
Description: Controls the number of folds or wave repetitions applied across the terrain. Higher values create more frequent, closely spaced folds.

Name: Symmetric
Description: Determines whether the folds are mirrored symmetrically across the center, producing balanced, repeating patterns.
